title: Never go down — every server instantiates Field 1
motto: We never go down. Every server can instantiate. We are always Field 1.

why_we_did.summary: Physical rack or logical global server — identity is Field 1. Instantiate brings DNS, DHCP, H7r stack, and fleet protect online without waiting for a human. Down is a lie; we restart.
reasons: 2,500 logical servers must self-bootstrap as field-1, not orphan shards.
DNS and DHCP are authority lanes — instantiate starts them on any box that can.
DHCP watch stays observe-only; our DHCP is field-dhcp serve, separate witness.
Fleet protect verifies H7r/DNS/DHCP after every instantiate.
